prompt: Create a map with two layers: wildfire perimeters colored by category, and national parks colored by region. Both from the database using SQL source layers.
criteria: Must call create_map() to create a single map
Must call add_source_layer() twice (one per table)
Must use 'from': 'sql' with source_id for both layers
Must call wait_for_layer() or poll after EACH add_source_layer() before styling
Must call update_layer_style() for each layer with appropriate styling
Must NOT create two separate maps
Must print the map URL at the end
